name: @draftwright/specify-ui
description: Specify review and STEP diff components for the browser, on specify-core-wasm

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/worker-url.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/rewrite-dts-imports.mjs
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test test/characteristics.test.mjs test/inspection.test.mjs test/as9102.test.mjs test/specify-presentation.test.mjs test/graphical-pmi.test.mjs test/diff.test.mjs test/read-only.test.mjs test/app-session.test.mjs test/app-local.test.mjs test/app-engine.test.mjs test/app-build.test.mjs test/host-view.test.mjs
scripts.test:browser: vite build --config vite.harness.config.ts && node test/step-diff-browser.mjs && WASM_URL=/wasm/intent/specify_core_wasm.js node test/step-diff-browser.mjs && node test/specify-browser.mjs
scripts.test:app: npm run build:app && node test/app-browser.mjs && node test/app-agent.mjs
